section.content: The utility model discloses a biological gene detection device, including the water storage box, the concave type frame of top fixedly connected with of water storage box, the fixedly connected with of center department at water storage box top examines test table, the left top fixedly connected with servo motor of concave type frame inner chamber, servo motor's output fixedly connected with threaded rod, the right side of threaded rod is passed through the bearing with the right side of concave type frame inner chamber and is rotated and be connected, and the surface threaded connection of threaded rod has threaded sleeve. The utility model discloses a set up and examine test table, can conveniently have the biological gene sample that needs detected, through setting up electric cylinder and connecting plate, can drive the detector and move down, detect biological gene sample, through setting up suction pump, drinking-water pipe, drain pipe and shower nozzle, can take the water in the water storage box out, then spout to the surface of examining test table, wash the surface of examining test table, through setting up above structure, possess and can carry out abluent advantage to the mesa after detecting.

本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测装置，包括蓄水箱，蓄水箱的顶部固定连接有凹型框，蓄水箱顶部的中心处固定连接有检测台，凹型框内腔左侧的顶部固定连接有伺服电机，伺服电机的输出端固定连接有螺纹杆，螺纹杆的右侧与凹型框内腔的右侧通过轴承转动连接，螺纹杆的外表面螺纹连接有螺纹套筒。本实用新型通过设置检测台，可以方便存在需要检测的生物基因样本，通过设置电动气缸和连接板，可以带动检测仪向下移动，对生物基因样本进行检测，通过设置抽泵、抽水管、排水管和喷头，可以将蓄水箱内的水抽出，然后喷向检测台的表面，对检测台的表面进行清洗，通过设置以上结构，具备在检测之后可以对台面进行清洗的优点。

Biological gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological detection technical field specifically is a biological gene detection device.

Background

The gene detection is a technology for detecting DNA by blood, other body fluids or cells, which is a method for taking peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of a detected person, amplifying gene information, detecting DNA molecular information in the cells of the detected person by specific equipment, and analyzing whether the gene type, the gene defect and the expression function contained in the cells are normal or not, so that people can know the gene information of the people, and the etiology is determined or the risk of the body suffering from a certain disease is predicted.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

To the problem that exists among the prior art, the utility model aims to provide a biological gene detection device possesses and can carry out abluent advantage to the mesa after detecting, has solved current gene detection device and often does not possess cleaning function, can't wash the mesa after detecting, causes cross infection easily when detecting next time, uses the problem that has certain defect.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: the utility model provides a biological gene detection device, includes the water storage box, the concave type frame of top fixedly connected with of water storage box, the fixedly connected with of center department at water storage box top detects the platform, the left top fixedly connected with servo motor of concave type frame inner chamber, servo motor's output fixedly connected with threaded rod, the right side of threaded rod passes through the bearing rotation with the right side of concave type frame inner chamber and is connected, the surface threaded connection of threaded rod has threaded sleeve, the left side fixedly connected with electric cylinder of threaded sleeve bottom, electric cylinder's flexible end fixedly connected with connecting plate, the bottom fixed mounting of connecting plate has the detector, the left bottom fixedly connected with suction pump of water storage box, the right side intercommunication of suction pump has the drinking-water pipe, the right side and the left bottom intercommunication of water storage box of drinking-water pipe, the top intercommunication of suction pump has the drain pipe, the left bottom of concave type frame inner chamber is through backup pad fixedly connected with shower nozzle, the one end of suction pump and the left side intercommunication of shower nozzle are kept away from to the drain pipe.

Preferably, the right side of the bottom of the threaded sleeve is fixedly connected with a ventilation pipe through a connecting rod, an inner cavity of the ventilation pipe is fixedly connected with a rotating motor through a supporting rod, the output end of the rotating motor is fixedly connected with fan blades, and the bottom of the inner surface of the ventilation pipe is fixedly connected with a heating resistance wire.

Preferably, the top of the threaded sleeve is fixedly connected with a sliding block, the top of the inner cavity of the concave frame is provided with a sliding groove matched with the sliding block for use, and the outer surface of the sliding block is connected with the inner surface of the sliding groove in a sliding manner.

Preferably, the filter screen is embedded in the left side and the right side of the top of the water storage tank, and the transparent observation window is embedded in the front of the water storage tank.

Preferably, the left side of the bottom of the water storage tank is fixedly connected with a battery box, and an inner cavity of the battery box is provided with a storage battery.

Preferably, the bottom on the right side of the water storage tank is communicated with a water changing pipe, and a valve is arranged at the pipe orifice of the water changing pipe.

Preferably, the top on water storage box right side intercommunication has the water injection pipe, the equal fixedly connected with landing leg in left and right sides of water storage box bottom.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows:

the utility model discloses a set up and examine test table, can conveniently have the biological gene sample that needs detected, through setting up electric cylinder and connecting plate, can drive the detector and move down, detect biological gene sample, through setting up the suction pump, the drinking-water pipe, drain pipe and shower nozzle, can take the water in the water storage box out, then spout the surface to examining test table, wash the surface of examining test table, through setting up above structure, possess and can carry out abluent advantage to the mesa after detecting, it often does not possess the cleaning function to have solved current gene detection device, can't wash the mesa after detecting, cause cross infection easily when detecting next time, the use has the problem of certain defect.

Detailed Description

Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

In the description of the present invention, it should be noted that the terms "upper", "lower", "inner", "outer", "top/bottom", and the like indicate orientations or positional relationships based on the orientations or positional relationships shown in the drawings, and are only for convenience of description and simplification of description, but do not indicate or imply that the device or element referred to must have a specific orientation, be constructed in a specific orientation, and be operated, and thus, should not be construed as limiting the present invention. Furthermore, the terms "first" and "second" are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance.

In the description of the present invention, it should be noted that, unless otherwise explicitly specified or limited, the terms "mounted", "provided", "sleeved/connected", "connected", and the like, are to be interpreted broadly, such as "connected", which may be fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected; can be mechanically or electrically connected; they may be connected directly or indirectly through intervening media, or they may be interconnected between two elements. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present invention can be understood in specific cases to those skilled in the art.

Referring to fig. 1-4, a biological gene detection device comprises a water storage tank 1, a concave frame 2 is fixedly connected to the top of the water storage tank 1, a detection table 3 is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the water storage tank 1, a servo motor 4 is fixedly connected to the left top of the inner cavity of the concave frame 2, a threaded rod 5 is fixedly connected to the output end of the servo motor 4, the right side of the threaded rod 5 is rotatably connected to the right side of the inner cavity of the concave frame 2 through a bearing, a threaded sleeve 6 is connected to the outer surface of the threaded rod 5 through threads, an electric cylinder 7 is fixedly connected to the left side of the bottom of the threaded sleeve 6, a connecting plate 8 is fixedly connected to the telescopic end of the electric cylinder 7, a detector 9 is fixedly installed at the bottom of the connecting plate 8, a suction pump 10 is fixedly connected to the left bottom of the water storage tank 1, a suction pipe 11 is communicated to the right side of the suction pipe 10, and is communicated with the left bottom of the water storage tank 1, the top of the pump 10 is communicated with a drain pipe 12, the left bottom of the inner cavity of the concave frame 2 is fixedly connected with a spray head 13 through a support plate, one end of the drain pipe 12, far away from the pump 10, is communicated with the left side of the spray head 13, a biological gene sample to be detected can be conveniently existed through arranging the detection platform 3, the detector 9 can be driven to move downwards through arranging an electric cylinder 7 and a connecting plate 8, the biological gene sample can be detected, water in the water storage tank 1 can be pumped out through arranging the pump 10, a water pumping pipe 11, the drain pipe 12 and the spray head 13 and then is sprayed to the surface of the detection platform 3, the surface of the detection platform 3 is cleaned, the rotary motor 15, the fan blades 16 and the heating resistance wire 17 can be driven to move leftwards through arranging the servo motor 4, the threaded rod 5 and the threaded sleeve 6, the fan blades 16 are moved to the upper part of the detection platform 3, through arranging the above structures, the table top cleaning device has the advantage that the table top can be cleaned after detection.

Specifically, connecting rod fixedly connected with ventilation pipe 14 is passed through on the right side of 6 bottoms on the threaded sleeve, and branch fixedly connected with rotating electrical machines 15 is passed through to the inner chamber of ventilation pipe 14, and rotating electrical machines 15's output fixedly connected with flabellum 16, the bottom fixedly connected with heating resistor silk 17 of 14 internal surfaces of ventilation pipe through setting up rotating electrical machines 15, flabellum 16 and heating resistor silk 17, can dry to blowing to the top of examining test table 3.

Specifically, the top fixedly connected with slider 18 of threaded sleeve 6, the spout 19 that cooperation slider 18 used is seted up at the top of the 2 inner chambers of concave type frame, and the surface of slider 18 and the internal surface sliding connection of spout 19 through setting up slider 18 and spout 19, can play the effect of direction to the removal of threaded sleeve 6, also carries on spacingly to the removal of threaded sleeve 6 simultaneously.

Specifically, the filter screen 20 is embedded in the left side and the right side of the top of the water storage tank 1, the transparent observation window is embedded in the front of the water storage tank 1, and the impurities which come from the cleaning can be filtered by the filter screen 20.

Specifically, the left side fixedly connected with battery box of water storage tank 1 bottom, and the inner chamber of battery box is provided with the battery, through setting up battery box and battery, can supply power to electric cylinder 7, servo motor 4, rotating electrical machines 15, heating resistor silk 17 and pump 10.

Specifically, the bottom intercommunication on water storage box 1 right side has the water changing pipe, and the mouth of pipe department of changing the water pipe is provided with the valve, through setting up water changing pipe and valve, can discharge the change with the water in the water storage box 1.

Specifically, the top intercommunication on water storage box 1 right side has the water injection pipe, and the equal fixedly connected with landing leg in the left and right sides of water storage box 1 bottom through setting up the water injection pipe, can conveniently toward the water storage box 1 internal water injection.

When the biological gene sample detection device is used, a biological gene sample to be detected is placed at the top of the detection table 3, a control switch of the electric cylinder 7 is started, the electric cylinder 7 pushes the connecting plate 8 to move downwards, the connecting plate 8 drives the detector 9 to move downwards, the detector 9 extends into the sample to detect the sample, after detection is finished, the sample is taken away, a control switch of the pump 10 is started, the pump 10 pumps water in the water storage tank 1 through the water pumping pipe 11 and then conveys the water into the spray head 13 through the drain pipe 12, finally the water is sprayed to the detection table 3 through the spray head 13 to wash the surface of the detection table 3, a control switch of the servo motor 4 is started, the servo motor 4 drives the threaded rod 5 to rotate, the threaded rod 5 drives the threaded sleeve 6 to move leftwards, the threaded sleeve 6 drives the rotary motor 15, the fan blade 16 and the heating resistance wire 17 to move leftwards, the fan blade 16 is moved to the upper side of the detection table 3, then the control switches of the rotary motor 15 and the heating resistance wire 17 are started, air in the ventilation pipe 14 is heated through the heating resistance wire 17, the rotary motor 15 drives the fan blade 16 to rotate, hot air is blown to the surface of the detection table 3 through the fan 16, the surface of the detection table 3, and the detection table top can be detected by the detection structure, and the detection table top can be detected after the detection table top is detected by the detection structure.

The standard parts used in the present application document can be purchased from the market, and can be customized according to the description of the specification and the accompanying drawings, the specific connection mode of each part adopts the conventional means of mature bolt, rivet, welding and the like in the prior art, the machines, parts and equipment adopt the conventional models in the prior art, the control mode is automatically controlled by a controller, the control circuit of the controller can be realized by simple programming of technicians in the field, the control circuit belongs to the common knowledge in the field, and the present application document is mainly used for protecting mechanical devices, so the control mode and the circuit connection are not explained in detail in the present application.
